note: Names, descriptions and grades are the official PlayStation list as published by Exophase / PSNProfiles. Guides are written in our own words for this entry; kinds are derived from the official descriptions. Sources are the pages actually consulted.

trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one pops on its own — it is always the last trophy you get, so there is nothing to do for it directly. Follow the roadmap: finish the story, clear the 100% checklist, then mop up the miscellaneous feats. No online play or DLC is needed; everything is single-player.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Play the opening mission Gone Fishing in Chapter 1 and finish it. It is the first story mission, so this is the first trophy most players earn, and it cannot be missed — just follow the story prompts until the mission ends.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 1 to its end. The trophy pops when the chapter closes and the next chapter begins, so there is nothing extra to do — keep playing the main missions in order until the chapter ends.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2 the same way: play its main missions in order until the chapter ends and the trophy pops. Story trophies cannot be missed — if you are mid-chapter, just keep going.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3 by playing its main missions through to the end. The trophy unlocks automatically when the chapter closes, so no side content is needed for it.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4 by finishing its main missions in order. Like every chapter trophy, it pops on its own when the chapter ends and cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Finish the final story mission. This is the last story trophy and it pops when the mission ends; after it you keep free-roam for the cleanup. Keep a manual save from before the final mission — there is no mission replay, so a save is your only way back to it.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run in Chapter 2. Mission trophies unlock automatically when the mission ends — you cannot miss this one, just play the mission when it appears in the story.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist in Chapter 3. It is a main-mission trophy, so it pops when the heist ends and cannot be missed — play the mission when the story brings it to you.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play in Chapter 4. Like the other mission trophies it unlocks automatically at the end of the mission, so just play through the story.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners in Chapter 4. A story-mission trophy: it pops when the mission ends, with nothing extra to do and no way to miss it.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown in Chapter 4. Play the mission when the story offers it and the trophy unlocks at its end — automatic and unmissable.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Complete the late-story mission Operation Savage Glory. It is a main-mission trophy, so it unlocks automatically when the mission ends and cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion after the story — progress made during the story already counts — and finish the checklist. It is deliberately lenient, closer to 60% of everything in the game: any 100 optional missions, 200 of 277 vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied, 70 of 80 challenges, all robberies, all shooting ranges, all drone races and all 15 of Bret's Target Decks. Nothing on the checklist is missable and it can all be done in post-story free-roam. This is the longest trophy in the game, so treat it as the endgame.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts across Leonida: 130 stunt jumps, 202 flights under bridges, 40 knife flights between buildings and 25 base jumps. Mix the categories freely and pick the easiest ones — flying under bridges is the quickest. Track progress under Progress > Activities > Stunts and find stunt spots on the map under Exploration. The 100% checklist wants 300 stunts, so keep going past 250 if you are chasing A Long Road.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types at least once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a race (car race, race challenge or Top Fun drone race) and performing a stunt. Check Progress > Activities to see which types you have done; the map's Activities filter (blue dumbbell icon) marks most of them. You will tick most of these off naturally while working on other trophies.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across the 12 ranges. Gold is the top tier at each range: take your time, learn each range's layout and replay challenges until gold. The medals are not especially hard, and practising here also builds the Focus stat used by Gunslinger.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every one of the 14 locations (42 races in total). You only need one win per location, not every race. Learn each course's line, win once, then move on to the next location.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. There are 40 unique race locations, so you can skip the ones you find hardest. Any race type counts — car races, race challenges and Top Fun drone races all feed the activity list — but for this trophy win 20 distinct race events.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, when you have met Cal, watch for his text message: it marks a fishing spot with a purple icon. Follow Cal's fishing questline and beat him in the fishing challenge he sets. Fishing is one of the 9 activity types, so this also helps Master of None.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Finish any one of the 4 arcade games (listed in-game as Video Games): Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind or Bang For Your Buck. The first three are playable on the TV at home using the controllers; Bang For Your Buck is on arcade machines around the world. You must reach the end of a game — finishing all its levels once — but you do not need to beat every challenge inside it. Pick whichever game you enjoy most.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's questline, which is exclusive to Lucia. It is marked automatically in Chapter 3: while playing as Lucia you get a call from Andy, then a text with her address in Belville. Complete all 5 of her quests — Climbing the Cellerichain (parts 1-3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label and Puff Puff Pass — and the trophy pops after the last one. Her quests stay available after the story.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's questline. It is marked automatically in Chapter 1, a while after the mission Island Dreams: Kenton calls, then shows as a green KR icon in Key Lento. He sends you diving for treasure at 7 shipwrecks — find the chests with the metal detector on the ocean floor and bring them back. Track progress under Progress > Characters > Kenton Rees. Kenton goes quiet for a stretch of the story but comes back (playing as Jason in Chapters 2-3, or call Brian as Jason to nudge it), so nothing here is missable.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's questline, marked automatically after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. Complete his 5 quests — Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler and Hometown Heroes — and the trophy pops after the last. All of them stay available after the story.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers around Leonida. Only certain questlines count — the named character chains such as Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not. Strands confirmed to count include Kirk (the Skunk Ape hunts), Kyle (McKittrick Farm), Yago (street-racing mentorship) and Pilot Pete (deliveries). Strangers stay available in free-roam after the story; check the trophy tracker to see how many strands you have finished.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's questline. It is marked automatically after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs, where you steal the Zorrusso for Randy and unlock the Key Cloner. Randy then hands you a wish list of 16 sports cars to steal and deliver to his garage in west Vice City (green RK icon); scan cars with the WAiNK app to check whether one is on the list, and deliver in good condition for more money. The list includes the Zorrusso, Vitello, Infernus, Windsor Drop, Toros, Tempesta, Paragon, Jagular, Jubilee, Itali RSX, Growler, Gauntlet Hellfire, Furia, Dubsta, Banshee and Baller ST-D. All of it can be done after the story.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's questline, which is exclusive to Jason. It is marked automatically after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty: purple markers appear for Synthetic Labs in Vice City. Destroy the labs in the quest Take Out Kitty Litter, then Tyrone gives you the second quest, Spin On This, to shut the labs down — finishing it pops the trophy. Everything stays available after the story.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida — 18 meditation spots at 10 locations. Either character can meditate at a spot, and doing it with both Jason and Lucia at the same spot counts twice. Track them under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations. For the 100% checklist only 15 of 18 spots are needed.
trophies.missable_reason: Potentially missable: one extra meditation in Chapter 1, on the balcony at Jason's house, disappears after Chapter 1. After the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning — she says she is going to meditate and walks to the balcony. Follow her, accept the optional quest and let her teach you. It is not yet confirmed whether the trophy needs this one, so do it while you can.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret Vogel. Bret's questline is exclusive to Jason and is marked after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when Bret texts you about the quest Veteran Hunted in Lummox County. Meet Bret, take the hunting quests he marks with purple icons, and bring the animals back to him. He gives you the unique hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69 on the first quest; a clean one-shot kill leaves the animal pristine and pays more. His 15 Target Decks are also part of the 100% checklist, so this chain feeds A Long Road too.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. Cards are hidden around Leonida and there are 18 card-set locations in total. You do not need every card in the game — just three full sets. Collect them as you explore, and use the map's Exploration view to track which sets you have finished.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Scan 100 locations with the WAiNK app: hold Up on the D-pad to open it, then hold R1 while looking at a landmark, curiosity or sculpture. There are well over 100 scannable spots (31 landmarks, 35 curiosities and 23 sculptures are listed), so scan whatever you pass — any 100 count. This pairs naturally with Whip It Good, since the same app scans vehicles.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges. Track them under Progress > Challenges. Most complete naturally while you work on other trophies; save this for late in the run, then pick the easiest remaining ones. The 100% checklist needs 70 of 80, so you will pass 50 on the way to A Long Road.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level and then escape the heat. This opens after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when Jason and Lucia can free-roam together — call your partner with Right on the D-pad + Triangle. Cause chaos until you hit 4 stars, then break out of the red heat zone on a fast bike, cutting through traffic; if a helicopter is on you, shoot it down. A reliable escape route is the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County, where police and helicopters struggle to follow. You will also get this naturally during the bank-vault robberies, which always trigger 4 stars.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops back-to-back without losing your wanted level. Open after Coffee Break (Chapter 2): call your partner, then hit 3 robbery targets (green map icons) in a row while the police are chasing you — keep the flashing red/blue wanted level the whole time, never dropping to a clean escape or rising into full heat. Bring an armoured vest, sticky bombs and healing items from Ammu-Nation. A good spot is the 3 jewellery stores in north Vice City, available after Yasmani's Jewellery Jobs in Chapter 3: loot items in each store, break the safe with sticky bombs, and keep moving. The trophy pops about half a minute after you leave the third shop; if it does not, hit a fourth.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Open the WAiNK app (hold Up) and scan vehicles as you pass them — hold R1 while looking at one. Standing on a busy road and scanning passing traffic is the fastest way; you only need to scan a vehicle, not drive it. There are 557 vehicles in the game, and the 100% checklist needs 200 of 277 base models scanned, so keep scanning past 100.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Defeat 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Activate it with L3 + R3 while aiming: time slows and weak points are highlighted, but the purple focus bar drains in seconds. Prepare first — eat or drink to buff focus, carry Adrenaline (hold L1, press Triangle) to extend it, wear body armour, and use an accurate full-auto rifle such as the Duke 556. Line up 5 enemies at a gang operation and take them down quickly without missing. Focus has 4 levels, raised by shooting-range challenges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots; at level 4 this is much easier. Note it does not seem to count against soldiers, police or civilians.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a large passenger plane docked at a departure terminal at Vice City International Airport and fly away. Only a plane connected to a passenger boarding bridge counts — not one parked on the airfield. The easiest is at terminals E3/E4: drive through a fence onto the airfield, take the stairs by the boarding bridge straight into the plane, climb to the cockpit, reverse to the runway and take off. You must fly about 1 km away from the airport before the trophy pops, so keep flying until it does.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Steal a military tank (a Rhino) and use it. Tanks sit at Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County, in the south of the base. Drive in through the gate (or use the stunt jump by the south-east entrance), climb into a tank and open fire until the trophy pops. Expect heavy resistance — this is a combat trophy, not a stealth one.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewellery store without being detected. First finish the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewellery Jobs: it unlocks the Snap Gun, which silently picks alarmed doors, and marks jewellery-store robberies (green icons) on the map. Enter through the back door with the Snap Gun — do not kick the door, which trips the alarm — find the note with the safe code in the back room, open the safe and loot it. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good first target.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. Unlock them with the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is…: tail a security van to a bank, slip in while the vault is open, and bring your partner — you cannot carry all the cash alone, so hand off a bag with Right on the D-pad. After that mission, pay Yasmani $10,000 per tip (after his earlier Payday Loans quests) to mark more security vans. Each robbery triggers a 4-star wanted level, so escape on a fast motorcycle and switch cars to break recognition. There are 8 large bank jobs in total and the 100% checklist needs all 8, so you will earn this on the way.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armoured truck and escape. The same Chapter 4 mission that opens bank vaults (That's Where The Money Is…) counts as an armoured-truck robbery, so you will likely earn this automatically. For an earlier shot: find armoured trucks driving near banks in Vice City, block one, stick a bomb on its back door and blow it open — sticky bombs are in the back of Yasmani's shop after his quests. Either way, the trophy only pops once you escape the red heat radius, so get clear before you celebrate.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Fully explore Leonida — unfog the entire map. The fastest way is by plane: fly over every blacked-out area until the whole map is visible. Do this after the story when you can fly freely, and pair it with stunt flying and vehicle scanning on the way.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. There are 39 illegal operations in total; you only need one per gang for this trophy, but the 100% checklist needs all 39, so keep going. Operations show as yellow icons when you get near them, and many are marked automatically from story progress. Track per-gang progress under Progress > Gangs.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to the beachfront bars on Ocean Beach in Vice City and order a cocktail — the trophy is about the moment, not a mission. Note: at launch no guide has confirmed the exact trigger for this one, so if it does not pop at the first bar, try the other beachfront spots and check the trophy tracker. (PowerPyx lists this trophy's method as currently unknown.)
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Steal the blue Banshee from the vehicle showroom in south Vice City and drive it straight out through the showroom window. You need the Key Cloner first, unlocked in the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs. Hack into the Banshee, drive forward through the glass, and keep driving — the trophy pops a moment later, once you are out on the street. It only counts with this specific blue Banshee, a nod to the Banshee from GTA III.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, one of the gang operations. Go during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling, which marks it automatically — bring sticky bombs from Ammu-Nation first. Inside, grab the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on the table in the north-east corner, and blow open the safe in the north-east hallway. The trophy pops after you escape the police, not when you pick up the third item. You do not need all three in one visit: if you miss one, the robbery icon respawns later and you can come back for the rest.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: Reach maximum strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. This opens after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when you can switch between the two. Check strength under Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > Strength (heart icon). Work out at fitness clubs — buy a membership, and always bring your partner (Right on the D-pad + Triangle) so both train at once: while one works out, the other completes their training automatically. Gyms are marked under Map > Activities, and you can also work out at home after the story.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your criminal profile. Turn on profile notifications first (Settings > UI > HUD Notifications > Criminal Profile = On): a small demon face appears whenever an action counts. The profile runs from Professional (clean, stealthy jobs) through Hardened and Violent to Psycho and finally Irredeemable — the last is permanent and makes police far more aggressive, so avoid farming it. Most of the 500 will happen passively through robberies and fights on the way to the platinum; if you are short at the end, any profile-affecting act counts.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. At launch no guide has confirmed this trophy's trigger; it is believed to be tied to the Payday Loans store from the prologue. Try succeeding on a second attempt at something you failed first — the name suggests a retry that lands. Check the trophy tracker and community guides as launch-era information firms up. (PowerPyx lists this trophy's method as currently unknown.)
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: Complete the UFO easter egg. Go alone, at night after 2AM, to the road north-west of Starlet Motel in Kelly County. Sometimes a blinking car is parked at the roadside — if it is not there, drive away and come back until it appears. Follow the path from the car into the woods and you will see the UFO's bright blue light in the sky. Approach it: it drops a woman it abducted. Talk to her, offer to help, and walk her back to her car at the roadside to pop the trophy. The spawn is slightly random, so be patient.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl them over with a melee drive-by. At launch no guide has confirmed the exact method; it is believed to be kicking enemies over while driving a motorcycle — a melee attack from a moving bike. Try knocking enemies down with a melee swing while riding past them. Check the trophy tracker and community guides as launch-era information firms up. (PowerPyx lists this trophy's method as currently unknown.)
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 in marked bills through your contacts. First finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check, which unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer for laundering. Then rob banks and Payday Loans stores and carry the marked bills to a fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. The $250,000 is cumulative across all robberies, not a single haul; bank vaults pay up to $205,000 each. You will get most of it naturally while robbing the 8 bank vaults for the 100% checklist.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 in total across all shops. The fastest way is the expensive stuff: guns at Ammu-Nation, car mods, and tattoos. There are 24 gun stores, 14 mod shops, 67 clothing stores, 18 hair and beauty salons, 11 tattoo studios, 15 electronics stores and more — spending anywhere counts, so just buy the gear you want and it will come.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garages (4 more are story-related and do not count). Garages go on sale after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver, when the Vice City Real Estate app appears on your phone. They cost $160,000 in total. Robberies are the quickest money, especially the higher-value ones in Chapters 3-4, so fund this late in the run.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app. The app is installed after the Chapter 2 mission where you take a vehicle to Moses. Each garage you own adds parking spots, so buy garages first (see Little Boxes). Then drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn and choose Respray then Register in his garage — at first he only takes vehicles without trackers, and from Chapter 3 you can also register standard-tracker cars at any Pay 'n' Spray. Registration costs money, so use cheap low-end cars and bikes.
trophies.name: On the Spot
